panels.title: Cache Utilization

panels.description: One point per priced model: X is average cost per priced call, Y is p95 successful latency. No composite best-model score is calculated.
panels.noValue: No priced successful models in this time range.

targets.query: WITH s AS (SELECT provider||'/'||model AS m,latency_ms,cost_usd,success FROM calls_v WHERE ('${model:raw}'='__all' OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000),r AS (SELECT m,latency_ms,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY m ORDER BY latency_ms) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY m) cnt FROM s WHERE success=1),p AS (SELECT m,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=(cnt*95+99)/100 THEN latency_ms END) AS p95_ms FROM r GROUP BY m),c AS (SELECT m,COUNT(*) AS calls,SUM(cost_usd)/NULLIF(COUNT(cost_usd),0) AS cost_per_call FROM s GROUP BY m) SELECT c.m AS model,c.cost_per_call,p.p95_ms,c.calls FROM c JOIN p USING(m) WHERE c.cost_per_call IS NOT NULL
targets.queryText: WITH s AS (SELECT provider||'/'||model AS m,latency_ms,cost_usd,success FROM calls_v WHERE ('${model:raw}'='__all' OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000),r AS (SELECT m,latency_ms,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY m ORDER BY latency_ms) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY m) cnt FROM s WHERE success=1),p AS (SELECT m,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=(cnt*95+99)/100 THEN latency_ms END) AS p95_ms FROM r GROUP BY m),c AS (SELECT m,COUNT(*) AS calls,SUM(cost_usd)/NULLIF(COUNT(cost_usd),0) AS cost_per_call FROM s GROUP BY m) SELECT c.m AS model,c.cost_per_call,p.p95_ms,c.calls FROM c JOIN p USING(m) WHERE c.cost_per_call IS NOT NULL
targets.rawQueryText: WITH s AS (SELECT provider||'/'||model AS m,latency_ms,cost_usd,success FROM calls_v WHERE ('${model:raw}'='__all' OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000),r AS (SELECT m,latency_ms,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY m ORDER BY latency_ms) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY m) cnt FROM s WHERE success=1),p AS (SELECT m,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=(cnt*95+99)/100 THEN latency_ms END) AS p95_ms FROM r GROUP BY m),c AS (SELECT m,COUNT(*) AS calls,SUM(cost_usd)/NULLIF(COUNT(cost_usd),0) AS cost_per_call FROM s GROUP BY m) SELECT c.m AS model,c.cost_per_call,p.p95_ms,c.calls FROM c JOIN p USING(m) WHERE c.cost_per_call IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Cost vs Latency by Model

panels.description: Neutral sortable comparison of usage, cost, latency, reliability and cache ratio. No quality metric is collected; compare dimensions for your task and do not infer a single winner.
panels.noValue: No model calls in this time range.

targets.query: SELECT provider||'/'||model AS model,COUNT(*) AS requests,SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,ROUND(SUM(cost_usd)/NULLIF(COUNT(cost_usd),0),6) AS cost_per_call,ROUND(100.0*SUM(success)/NULLIF(SUM(1-is_cancelled),0),1) AS success_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(cache_read_tokens)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN input_tokens END),0),1) AS cache_ratio_pct,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)<20 THEN 'low sample' ELSE '' END AS note FROM calls_v WHERE ('${model:raw}'='__all' OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 25
